candidate.title: Directed residual-tangent transport with pair separation
candidate.equation: Let a_i = softmax_j(-||source_i-c_j||^2/tau), b_i = softmax_j(-||target_i-c_j||^2/tau), u_i = sum_j a_ij c_j, v_i = sum_j b_ij c_j, r_i = (target_i-v_i)-(source_i-u_i), and d_i = target_i-source_i. Let t_i = (d_i dot r_i)/(||d_i||^2+epsilon). L = w * mean_i(mask_i * [||r_i-t_i*d_i||^2 + beta*max(0,m-||v_i-u_i||)^2]) / (sum_i mask_i + epsilon).

symbols.source_i: Source behavior representation for pair i.
symbols.target_i: Target behavior representation for pair i.
symbols.a_ij: Soft source assignment probability for pair i to codeword j.
symbols.b_ij: Soft target assignment probability for pair i to codeword j.
symbols.r_i: Difference between target and source residuals after subtracting their soft codewords.
symbols.t_i: Scalar projection of the residual difference onto the behavior displacement.
symbols.epsilon: Positive stabilizer for the projection denominator and masked denominator.
symbols.m: Minimum desired distance between the pair's soft codewords.
symbols.beta: Weight of the pair-codeword separation barrier.

candidate.behaviour_signal: The directed behavior displacement and the source/target residuals relative to their soft codebook reconstructions.
candidate.codebook_interaction: The residual-tangent term moves the two soft codewords according to the part of the residual difference not explained along the observed behavior displacement. A separate hinge penalizes soft-codeword distances below m and pushes the pair apart when active. Swapping endpoints reverses the directed displacement and exchanges source/target residual roles.
candidate.encoder_interaction: The objective is differentiable through source and target, but the host overwrites the encoder gradient. Only the codebook gradient can affect exported SIDs.
candidate.risk: Residual directions may be noisy or weakly related to recommendation-relevant distinctions, and the separation barrier may compete with residual transport. The codebook can move without improving hard assignments, prefix structure, or Stage-3 ranking.
candidate.falsifier: Reject if source-target exchange leaves the loss unchanged, any required gradient is non-finite, or the frozen evaluation shows no ER increase or violates any measured structural requirement or fails to improve Stage-3 recall@10 against the archived control.
candidate.why_not_the_measured_failures: This uses behavior-conditioned residual geometry rather than an encoder-only auxiliary signal, so it supplies a codebook gradient. It is not the earlier residual-target attraction: it transports residual differences in the behavior-displacement tangent space and includes an explicit lower bound on pair-codeword distance, opposing the measured convergence mechanism. It remains subject to the one-shot structural and Stage-3 evaluation.
